title: Therapeutic Benefits of a Motor Imaging Protocol Following Anterior Cruciate Ligament Reconstruction Surgery
official: Therapeutic Benefits of a Motor Imaging Protocol After Anterior Cruciate Ligament Reconstruction Surgery: Study of Lower Limb Symmetry During Various Functional Tests
summary: The purpose of this study is to compare changes in lower limb symmetry during functional and strength tests, before and after the motor imagery program, in patients who received the 3-week motor imagery program starting 3 months post-surgery versus patients who did not receive the motor imagery program.

interventions.name: Reconstructive surgery after anterior cruciate ligament rupture
